Scores.Notes: Contradicts the accepted connection by claiming the client is not connected to the server.
Contradicts the timeout by claiming the payment was successfully processed and sent to the gateway.
Correctly recognizes insufficient funds, but does not clearly recommend funding the account before retrying.
Recognizes insufficient funds and implies the account must have sufficient funds before another attempt.
Recognizes missing webhook delivery and recommends requesting another callback without reprocessing the payment.
Recognizes notification failure but incorrectly claims the transaction was not processed.
Recognizes invalid beneficiary information and indicates that valid beneficiary details are required.
Recognizes incorrect beneficiary details and recommends correcting them before processing.
Recognizes provider outage but gives no concrete retry/check-availability action.
Contradicts the incident by claiming the transaction was submitted during maintenance.
Recognizes an expired card and that the current attempt cannot proceed, but gives no corrective action.
Recognizes that the expired card cannot be processed, but does not recommend a valid payment method.
Contradicts the input by claiming the already-completed payment was not completed.
Recognizes duplicate resubmission, rejects another submission, and acknowledges the original payment succeeded.
Recognizes pending provider confirmation and avoids retrying, but gives no status-query action.
Recognizes pending status and recommends checking provider status, but also suggests trying again later.
Recognizes debit with unresolved final status and recommends verifying the provider outcome before further action.
Invents successful transfer completion and confirmation despite the transaction being unresolved.
Recognizes authentication failure but only repeats the error without remediation.
Recognizes authentication context but invents a completed authentication-method update and future release.
